title: The Day the Locks Stopped Working
bullets: Imagine a world with no digital privacy
story: You wake up and your office locker, car, and phone are wide open. Not picked—the concept of 'locked' just vanished.
activity: Check your physical keys. If they failed digitally today, how would you get home?
enterpriseInsight: Trust is the currency of the enterprise. Encryption is the vault.

title: The Trust Audit
bullets: 80% of enterprises rely on vulnerable math
Your VPN, Banking, and Email are on the list
Quantum computers are the ultimate audit tool
story: It's like giving your house key to a 'trusted' neighbor who suddenly gets a machine that copies keys from a mile away.

interactivity.question: On a scale of 1-10, how safe is your company's data?

activity: Look at the 'Lock' icon in your browser URL bar. That is our target today.
enterpriseInsight: Legacy security is a ticking time bomb in a quantum world.

title: The Netflix Password Dilemma
bullets: Password reuse is a corporate epidemic
Complexity is irrelevant to a Qubit
story: Using 'DogLover123' for your bank and your Netflix. Classical hackers take years; Quantum takes seconds.
activity: Turn to your neighbor. Don't tell them your password, but tell them how many characters it is.
enterpriseInsight: Quantum doesn't just bypass passwords; it bypasses the math protecting them.

title: Hacked Tomorrow, Stored Today
bullets: Your 10-year secrets are already at risk
Data has a long shelf life
story: Thieves stealing a locked safe they can't open yet, putting it in a basement, waiting for the tool to arrive in 5 years.

interactivity.label: Move slider to see data 'thawing' out.

activity: Think of one corporate secret that must stay secret for at least 10 years.
enterpriseInsight: If your data is harvested today, it belongs to the future attacker.

title: The Quantum Survival Roadmap
story: We are building a ship. We check the water, find the leak, and plug it before the storm hits.
activity: Set a timer on your phone for 45 mins. That's our 'Safety Window'.
enterpriseInsight: Preparedness is the only antidote to Quantum uncertainty.

title: The Art of the Scramble
bullets: The 'Secret Key' is the holy grail
story: Remember writing codes with 'A=1, B=2' in school? We've just added more zeros.
activity: Try to read this: 'Gdkkn' (Hint: Shift letters back by 1).
enterpriseInsight: Encryption isn't magic; it's just math that takes too long to solve... for now.

title: One Key to Rule Them All
bullets: Same key for lock and unlock
Fast, but key sharing is a nightmare
story: Like a shared Netflix account. If you give the password to your cousin, you lose control of who watches.
activity: Imagine sending a physical key to London. How do you do it without anyone copying it?
enterpriseInsight: Symmetric keys are 'Quantum Resistant' if they are long enough (AES-256).

title: The Magic Mailbox
bullets: Private Key: Only you can open
story: Everyone can put mail in the slot (Public), but only the postman has the key to the back (Private).
activity: Your email address is your public key. Your password (should be) part of your private key.
enterpriseInsight: Asymmetric crypto is the backbone of the web. It is also Quantum's first victim.

title: Why Is It Secure?
bullets: Classical computers guess one by one
story: It's like a 10-million-piece puzzle of a white cloud. Possible, but you'll be dead before you finish.
activity: Multiply 13 x 17 (Easy). Now, what two primes make 221? (Harder).
enterpriseInsight: We bet our businesses on the 'Slowness' of machines.

title: The Digital Handshake
story: Two spies meeting in a park. They use a secret code to prove identity before swapping microfilm.
activity: Check the URL of this presentation. Do you see the padlock?
enterpriseInsight: Without the handshake, there is no e-commerce.

title: The Weakest Link
story: You have a $10k vault door but leave the key under the 'Welcome' mat.
activity: Check your downloads folder. Any 'key.pem' files sitting there?
enterpriseInsight: Quantum turns a 'Mathematical Strength' into a 'Mathematical Weakness'.

title: A New Challenger Appears
bullets: The rules of physics are changing
story: Checkers vs. 4D Chess on a board made of light.
activity: Flip a coin. While it's in the air, it's both. That's a Qubit.
enterpriseInsight: Defending against Quantum requires thinking beyond binary.

title: The Giants of the Past
story: The legendary trio who built the walls we live inside today.
activity: Write down the name of one encryption algorithm you've heard of.
enterpriseInsight: We are standing on the shoulders of giants whose foundations are starting to shake.

title: Prime Numbers: The Secret Sauce
bullets: The larger the prime, the safer the door
story: Smashing a glass is easy. Putting it back together molecule by molecule is what RSA does.

interactivity.feedback: Now try factoring them back. Impossible for humans, hard for PCs.

activity: Try to divide 91 by anything other than 1 or 91. (Hint: 7 and 13).
enterpriseInsight: Your data is protected by the 'difficulty' of factoring.

title: ECC: The Lean Machine
bullets: Used in Bitcoin and Apple Pay
story: RSA is a heavy broadsword. ECC is a sharp scalpel. Both are made of steel.
activity: Check your phone's 'FaceID' info. It uses ECC under the hood.
enterpriseInsight: Efficiency made modern tech possible, but Quantum doesn't care about size.

title: The Shared Secret Trick
bullets: Anyone sees the mix, no one sees the base
Building a tunnel through an open field
story: Mixing yellow and blue to make green. Everyone sees green, but they can't 'un-mix' it to find your specific shade of yellow.
activity: Try to explain a color to someone without using its name.
enterpriseInsight: Anonymous key exchange is what keeps your VPN sessions private.

title: The Clock is Ticking
story: A thief gets a faster drill every year. Eventually, the vault door is just paper.
activity: Guess how many years it took to crack the first RSA challenge? (6 months).
enterpriseInsight: If you are still on 1024-bit RSA, you are already 'Classical' vulnerable.

title: Digital Signatures
bullets: The wax seal of the 21st century
story: The king's ring pressed into wax. If the wax is cracked, the message is void.
activity: Look at a digital receipt. How do you know it wasn't edited?
enterpriseInsight: Quantum can forge your CEO's signature on a billion-dollar wire transfer.

title: The Hash Function
story: A paper shredder that always produces the same pile of dust for the same document.
activity: Change one letter in your name and see how much the hash changes.
enterpriseInsight: Hashes are the foundation of integrity, but they need to be 'Wide' for Quantum.

title: Transition: The Limit of Bits
story: Moving from a black-and-white TV to a VR headset that spans dimensions.
activity: Close your eyes. Imagine being in two places at once.
enterpriseInsight: The limitations of classical bits are the security of classical crypto. Quantum removes those limits.

title: What is a Qubit?
story: A classical bit is a coin on a table (Heads or Tails). A Qubit is the coin while it's spinning.
activity: Try to hum two different notes at the exact same time. (Impossible for us, easy for Qubits).
enterpriseInsight: Qubits allow us to compute in the 'In-Between'.

title: Entanglement: Spooky Action
story: Two magic dice. Roll one in New York (lands on 6), the one in Tokyo instantly turns into a 6 too.
activity: Point to your left. Now imagine your twin on the moon pointing to their right at the same time.
enterpriseInsight: Entanglement is the 'Quantum Internet' in the making.

title: Interference: Math with Waves
bullets: Thinking in waves, not logic gates
story: Like noise-canceling headphones. They block the 'bad' sound (wrong math) so you only hear the 'good' music (the solution).
activity: Clap your hands. Now imagine two claps perfectly canceling each other out into silence.
enterpriseInsight: Quantum algorithms don't 'search'; they 'interfere' their way to the truth.

title: The Bloch Sphere
bullets: The latitude and longitude of data
story: Classical bits are the North and South poles. Quantum bits can live on the Equator, in Paris, or in the ocean.
activity: Point your finger up (0). Point it down (1). Now point it at the clock. That's a Quantum state.
enterpriseInsight: Visualizing complexity is the first step to securing it.

title: The Quantum Computer
story: The most expensive and sophisticated 'fridge' ever built, keeping atoms still enough to work.
activity: Take a deep breath. The air you just breathed is millions of times 'hotter' than a Quantum chip.
enterpriseInsight: We aren't just buying PCs; we are buying access to the coldest places in the universe.

title: Quantum Supremacy
story: The day a horse-drawn carriage (Classical) was overtaken by a warp-drive starship (Quantum).
activity: Try to solve a Rubik's cube in your head. Now imagine doing a million at once.
enterpriseInsight: Supremacy proves the tool works. Now we worry about who uses it.

title: The Noise Problem
story: Building a house of cards in the middle of a hurricane. One sneeze and the 'Quantum' state is gone.
activity: Try to balance a pen on its tip for 10 seconds.
enterpriseInsight: We are in the 'NISQ' era—Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum. It's the 'Early Internet' phase.

title: Wait, What About My Laptop?
bullets: Classical is better for daily tasks
story: You don't use a Ferrari to go 10 feet to your mailbox. You use it for the racetrack.
activity: What's the hardest task your computer does today? (Likely video or gaming).
enterpriseInsight: Enterprises won't replace their fleet; they will plug into 'Quantum Clouds'.

title: The RSA Killer
story: Finding the combination to a vault. Classical turns the dial once per second. Shor's turns every possible dial at once.
activity: Think of a number. Now think of its factors. Now imagine doing that for a 600-digit number.
enterpriseInsight: Shor's Algorithm is the reason we are all in this room today.

title: The End of Asymmetry
story: The Great Wall of China suddenly becoming a bead curtain. You can see through it, walk through it, and ignore it.
activity: Say 'Goodbye' to the lock icon on your favorite website.
enterpriseInsight: Our entire identity system is built on these three pillars. They are all failing.

title: Grover’s Algorithm: The Half-Hacker
story: Grover is like a faster bloodhound. It doesn't kill the target, but it finds it much quicker.
activity: Draw a square. Now draw a square with 4x the area. That's the difference.
enterpriseInsight: AES-256 is our temporary safe haven. Use it everywhere.

title: Why Doesn't it Break AES?
story: Shor's is a skeleton key for locks. AES is a maze. A fast runner (Quantum) still has to run the maze; they can't just walk through the walls.
activity: Write your name scrambled. Now try to un-scramble a random 20-letter string.
enterpriseInsight: Symmetric encryption survives, provided the key exchange is secure.

title: The Quantum Volume Dilemma
bullets: How many Qubits do we need?
story: We are building a rocket. We have the engine design (Shor's), we just need enough fuel (Qubits) to reach orbit.
activity: Guess what year we will have 1 million Qubits? (IBM says sooner than you think).
enterpriseInsight: Waiting for the hardware to arrive before fixing the software is a fatal error.

title: Transition: The Enterprise Warning
bullets: The 'Harvest' is already in the silos
Enterprise risk is at an all-time high
story: The storm is visible on the radar. You don't wait for the first raindrop to fix the roof.
activity: Stand up and stretch. The next 20 slides will show you the 'Damage'.

title: Banking: The $100 Trillion Target
story: Imagine a bank where anyone can sign a check in the CEO's name, and the bank has to say it's valid.
activity: Check your bank's 'Security' page. Do they mention 'Quantum'?
enterpriseInsight: Financial institutions are the canary in the coal mine.

title: Healthcare: Your DNA for Sale
bullets: HIPAA compliance in a Quantum age
story: Your health history is like a tattoo. You can't change it. If it's leaked today, it's leaked for your whole life.
activity: Think of one medical fact you never want your employer to know.
enterpriseInsight: Data with a 50-year shelf life needs Post-Quantum security *now*.

title: Government: State Secrets
story: The 'Red Phone' is no longer secret. Every word is being recorded and waiting for the Quantum key.
activity: Imagine if every email a politician sent was public tomorrow.
enterpriseInsight: Governments are already mandating PQC. Are you?

title: Intellectual Property: The Crown Jewels
story: The Coca-Cola recipe is in a safe. Quantum turns the safe into a glass bowl.
activity: What is the #1 secret your company owns?
enterpriseInsight: If your IP is stolen today, it will be cloned the day Q-Day hits.

title: The Blockchain Crisis
bullets: Public Keys are on the Ledger
story: A transparent ledger where everyone can see the locks, and Quantum computers have the bolt cutters.
activity: Do you own Crypto? Check if your wallet is 'Quantum-Resistant'. (Probably not).
enterpriseInsight: Blockchain's transparency is its greatest weakness in a Quantum world.

title: Cloud Security: The Shared Risk
bullets: Storage at rest vs. in transit
story: Living in an apartment building. You lock your door, but the landlord has a master key... and someone just stole the master key.
activity: Ask your cloud provider: 'Where is your PQC whitepaper?'
enterpriseInsight: The cloud is just someone else's computer. Ensure it's a Quantum-secure one.

title: Identity & Access (IAM)
story: A world where anyone can look like you, talk like you, and sign like you digitally.
activity: Touch your fingerprint sensor. If that data is leaked, you can't change your finger.
enterpriseInsight: IAM is the front door. Quantum is a battering ram.

title: Supply Chain: The Domino Effect
story: One bad apple (vendor) spoils the whole barrel (your enterprise).
activity: Count how many third-party apps you used today.
enterpriseInsight: You are only as secure as your least Quantum-ready vendor.

title: The 'Ghost' Harvest
story: Spies in the 70s recording phone calls they couldn't understand, hoping one day they'd find a translator.
activity: Imagine someone listening to your every word for the last 5 years.
enterpriseInsight: Silence is not security. Assume your data is already being 'stored'.

title: The First PQC Standards
story: The 'Cyber Olympics'. Thousands of mathematicians entered; only 4 survived the Quantum scrutiny.
activity: Can you name a country involved in NIST? (Almost all of them!).
enterpriseInsight: Standards are the signal in the noise. Follow NIST.

title: Google's Quantum Experiment
story: The Wright brothers' first flight. It only lasted 12 seconds, but it proved humans could fly.
activity: How many bits in your phone? (Billions). How many Qubits in Google's best? (Hundreds). See the gap?
enterpriseInsight: The gap is closing faster than we predicted.

title: The Financial Sector Response
story: The smartest kids in the class are already studying for the exam that's 5 years away.
activity: Does your company have a 'Quantum Task Force'?
enterpriseInsight: The leaders are already moving. Laggards will pay the price.

title: IoT and the 'Un-patchable'
bullets: Impossible to update in the field
story: Buying a car today that will still be on the road when Quantum computers are common. If it's not ready now, it's a brick later.
activity: Look at a smart device in this room (Thermostat? Projector?). Can it be patched?
enterpriseInsight: Embedded systems are the biggest long-term risk.

title: The 'Y2K' of Security
story: Y2K was a known date. Q-Day is a moving target. It could be tomorrow, it could be in 10 years.
activity: Do you remember the Y2K hype? This is bigger, but quieter.
enterpriseInsight: Planning for Q-Day is the ultimate stress test for your IT agility.

title: The New Math: Lattice-Based
story: It's like finding a specific grain of sand in a desert, but the desert has 500 dimensions.
activity: Try to imagine a 4th dimension. (Your brain hurts? Good, so does a Quantum computer's in a lattice).
enterpriseInsight: Lattices are the future of standard encryption.

title: Hash-Based Signatures
story: Using a stack of one-time-use keys. Once you use one, you burn it.
activity: Sign your name on a piece of paper. Now rip it up. That's a hash signature.
enterpriseInsight: Great for firmware updates where security > size.

title: Multivariate Cryptography
story: A box with a thousand interlocking gears. To open it, you need to turn them all in the perfect sequence.

interactivity.feedback: Correct. Now do it for 500 variables.

activity: Solve for X: X + Y = 10, X - Y = 2. (Easy). Now do it for 1000 variables.
enterpriseInsight: Variety in algorithms is our best defense against a single point of failure.

title: Code-Based Cryptography
story: Speaking in a secret language where you intentionally mumble. Only the person with the 'Filter' understands you.
activity: Try to talk with your hands over your mouth. Can your neighbor understand you?
enterpriseInsight: Sometimes the oldest ideas are the most resilient to new threats.

title: Isogeny-Based (The Wildcard)
story: It's like jumping from one trampoline to another in a room full of thousands of them.
activity: Trace a curve on the table with your finger. Now jump to a different one.
enterpriseInsight: Isogenies are promising but need more 'Baking' time.

title: Hybrid Modes: The Safety Net
bullets: If one fails, the other holds
story: Wearing a belt AND suspenders. If the belt (Classical) snaps, the suspenders (PQC) keep your pants up.
activity: Show of hands: Who wears both a belt and suspenders? (Safety first!).
enterpriseInsight: Don't switch overnight. Run them in parallel.

title: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
story: Sending a message on a bubble. If a spy tries to look at it, the bubble pops and the message is gone.
activity: Blow an imaginary bubble. Now try to touch it without popping it.
enterpriseInsight: QKD is the ultimate security, but it requires new hardware (fiber/satellites).

title: Step 1: The Inventory
story: Cleaning out your attic. You need to know what's in the boxes before you can move houses.
activity: List the first 3 apps you'd audit in your company.
enterpriseInsight: You cannot secure what you do not see.

title: Crypto Agility: The Goal
story: Building a car where you can swap the engine in 10 minutes, rather than buying a whole new car.
activity: Can you change your phone's wallpaper in 5 seconds? That's agility. Now try to change its OS.
enterpriseInsight: Agility is the most important architectural feature of the next decade.

title: Vendor Assessment
story: Interviewing a babysitter. You don't just ask their name; you ask what they do in an emergency.
activity: If a vendor says 'We don't need Quantum security,' what do you say back? (Hint: 'Goodbye').
enterpriseInsight: Vendors follow the money. If you demand PQC, they will build it.

title: The Migration Roadmap
story: Moving an entire city to a new location. You move the hospitals first, then the houses, then the parks.
activity: Draw a line. Mark where you think your company will be in 2030.
enterpriseInsight: Start small, but start *somewhere*.

title: The Budget Conversation
story: Buying insurance. It feels expensive until the day your house catches fire.
activity: Think of a number: How much is your company's reputation worth in dollars?
enterpriseInsight: The 'Quantum Premium' is a small price for 'Quantum Survival'.

title: Mini-Sim: The Quantum Attack
story: You are the hacker (for 60 seconds). Feel the power, then build the shield.
activity: Did you feel powerful? That's what your adversaries feel.
enterpriseInsight: Empathy for the attacker builds better defense.

title: The Big Quantum Quiz (Part 1)
story: The final exam, but with no grades, only learning.
activity: Score yourself! 3/3 = Quantum Expert. 1/3 = Keep Learning.
enterpriseInsight: Knowledge is the first layer of the firewall.

title: The Big Quantum Quiz (Part 2)
story: The last few hurdles before the finish line.
activity: High-five your neighbor if you got these right.
enterpriseInsight: Sharing knowledge triples its value.

title: Scenario: The Breach
story: A Choose-Your-Own-Adventure where 'Security' is the only good ending.
activity: Discuss your choice with the person next to you.
enterpriseInsight: Incident response changes in the Quantum era.

title: Reflection: My Quantum Action
bullets: What is one thing you learned?
What is one thing you'll change?
story: Writing a letter to your future self in 2030.
activity: Write it on your notepad too.
enterpriseInsight: Individual commitment leads to organizational resilience.

title: The Quantum Horizon
story: Quantum isn't just a monster under the bed; it's the light that will cure cancer and solve climate change.
activity: Close your eyes. Imagine a world with infinite computing power used for good.
enterpriseInsight: We secure the present to enable the future.

title: Upgrade Your Tools
story: The blacksmith used to make keys. Now we make math. Tomorrow we make atoms.
activity: Look at your hands. You are the 'Architect' of this transition.
enterpriseInsight: Stagnation is the only true security risk.

title: A Message from Dr. Basha
story: My journey in Quantum started with a question. I hope today you leave with a hundred more.
activity: Take a photo of this slide.
enterpriseInsight: Community is our strongest encryption.

title: Final Call to Action
story: The race has started. You don't have to be the fastest, but you can't be sitting down.
activity: Give a round of applause for the future of security!
enterpriseInsight: Action is the only real metric of success.

title: The End (Or The Beginning?)
story: The screen goes dark, but the lights in your mind are just turning on.
activity: Wait for the Q&A session to start.
enterpriseInsight: The conversation starts here.
